full_name: Jewel Pereyra | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Humanities Radcliffe Institute Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Jewel Pereyra is a doctoral candidate in Harvard's American Studies program, and her research spans 20th- and 21st-century Asian American literature and performance, comparative studies of race and ethnicity, US empire, and popular music and aesthetics.
